ThingDef.label: gene vat
ThingDef.description:
A biological processing workstation used to extract raw genetic biomass from organic materials.
Colonists manually process raw meat, raw plant food or whole organic corpses. A batch of 50 raw meat produces 25 raw biomass, or 38 when combined with 1 herbal medicine. A batch of 50 raw plant food produces 10 raw biomass. Corpse recovery depends on body size, remaining material and decay. Separate bills let you control which ingredients are used.
Extraction speed and experience use Cooking 40%, Medicine 40% and Intellectual 20%. The skill multiplier scales from 50% at level 0 to 100% at level 5 and 150% at level 10, with each skill capped independently at 10. General work speed, sight and manipulation also affect processing time. Skill does not change biomass yield. Artificial parts are recovered before corpse extraction, using separate medical surgery rules without medicine or cleanliness modifiers.
